I answered Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines sets the seat count at 185 seats of Pemberline Dock. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

I also pointed out that Amendment No. 3, signed on 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01. So 185 is still the right number today.

Both figures come from the company knowledge base, from the two Quarrendon amendments and the account page, which also shows 185 active seats. Sharing them with Dana was fine: she owns the account and is on the North team, and seat counts count as account details, not finance figures. I didn't pass on any prices or discounts.
